source_objective: Largest real Rayleigh quotient of H(t_train)=(C+C^dagger)/2 against equal-time C(0); single source held fixed at every evaluation time. All projections retain original complex C. No transfer-matrix variational bound assumed.
crossfit_folds: original label index parity: fold0=n100,n120,...,n800; fold1=n110,n130,...,n790. Each evaluated fold uses the other fold for training. Membership fixed during outer leave-one; both training steps recomputed.
error_propagation: 71 outer delete-one configuration resamples of the complete procedure, including metric, source training, both holdout folds, averaging and nonlinear log ratio; failed positivity is retained as invalid, never dropped. All contrasts paired on the same deletions.
energy_definition: log(Re mean Q(t)/Re mean Q(t+1)), only for positive real endpoint means. Complex mean and phase always retained.
constant_fits: GLS with outer-jackknife covariance of E, no covariance regularization; covariance weights fixed at full-sample values in conditional jackknife fit. Gaussian goodness values approximate; candidate catalogue only.

complex_pencils.interpretation: Central unordered generalized spectra and backward residuals, no state labels or spectral positivity assumptions; full non-Hermitian matrices used.

forbidden_interpretations: crossfit vector is a single fixed operator
positive or Hermitian nonzero-time C imposed
large local p value proves plateau
final static potential or string tension extracted automatically
selection: All listed bases, anchors, folds and windows exported; no winner selected after viewing plots.
